title: unaided-schedule
objective: The configuration every real install runs and no journey covered: the shipped default cadence, three real player turns, no runExtractionNow and no /cp — an extraction read must fire on its own, its deltas must carry evidence quoting what the player wrote, and the checkpoint it opens must apply its effects.

checks.goal: the SHIPPED default cadence is in effect (3), extraction is on, a profile is set, and nothing has read yet — so the read J12.3 observes cannot be a leftover from an earlier check or an earlier run

steps.eval: const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const snap = rt.getSnapshot(); const s = snap.extraction.settings; const audits = snap.extraction.audits ?? []; if (!s.enabled) throw new Error('extraction is off install-wide: this journey measures the shipped default, so it cannot run'); if (!s.profileId) throw new Error('no extraction profile is selected: run `so-ui.mts select-profile` or set one in the panel first'); if (s.cadence !== 3) throw new Error(`cadence is ${s.cadence}, not the shipped default 3. This journey cannot run at another cadence without losing its point, so it refuses rather than redefining itself. The value cannot be attributed from here: this install measured 3 on 2026-09-20 and 2026-09-21 10:17 and 1 from 2026-09-21 22:27 on (run headers in .debug/), so it is either the author's own choice or residue from a harness run that pre-dates the S11 capture/restore fix. Set it to 3 in the settings panel if that is what you want, which is also the shipped default.`); if (audits.length) throw new Error(`the audit ring already holds ${audits.length} entry/entries before this journey read anything: the audited read below could not be attributed to it`); return { cadence: s.cadence, enabled: s.enabled, profileId: s.profileId, audits: audits.length };

checks.goal: the story is selected and its requirements are GREEN — the guard v2.3 plan 04 added, because a journey that never established its lorebooks gets silent no-op latches instead of a failure, and the symptom then surfaces 300 s later as a checkpoint that never arrives

checks.goal: three real turns at the shipped cadence produce an extraction read with NO help (any reason but manual/trigger/runNow), it accepts deltas, and every such read's window holds the player's own lines. Rewritten 2026-09-23 (L2) from the audit tail: the check demanded the reason `cadence`, but a scene or cue read that fires first is just as unaided and resets the cadence counter, so in 3 of 3 real runs the schedule fired as `scene:cast` / `cue:*` and the read labelled `cadence` never came due. Whether a read reached the latest player message is reported, not asserted, for the same reason.

send_generate.text: I cross the guild hall to the quest counter and put both hands flat on the wood. "Tobias. The Wendhope posting. Tell me what it actually pays and who has already turned it down."
I listen him out without interrupting, then look at the two sitting near the board. "You two heard the same thing I did. Are you in?"
I sign the posting. "We take the Wendhope job. We leave at first light."

const snap = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.getSnapshot(); const audits = snap.extraction.audits ?? []; const ctx = globalThis.SillyTavern.getContext(); const players = (ctx.chat ?? []).map((m, i) => ({ i, isUser: m.is_user === true })).filter((m) => m.isUser); const lastPlayer = players.length ? players[players.length - 1].i : -1; const AIDED = /^(manual|trigger|runNow)/; const unaided = audits.filter((a) => !AIDED.test(String(a.reason ?? ''))); const playersIn = (w) => (ctx.chat ?? []).slice(Math.max(0, w.from), w.to + 1).filter((m) => m.is_user === true).map((m) => String(m.mes ?? '')); if (!unaided.length) throw new Error(`no unaided read: the reads this session produced were ${JSON.stringify(audits.map((a) => a.reason))}`); const taking = unaided.filter((a) => (a.acceptedDeltas ?? checks.goal: an accepted delta's EVIDENCE is a verbatim quote (at least 12 characters, quotes and whitespace normalized) of one of the player's own lines inside the read's window. Rewritten 2026-09-23 (L2): the token-overlap form excluded `cross`/`guild`/`counter` as generic, and a real run whose evidence was exactly the player's line "I cross the guild hall to the quest counter" failed on it. A verbatim quote is the stronger claim, and the one the extraction contract states.

steps.eval: const ctx = globalThis.SillyTavern.getContext(); const snap = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.getSnapshot(); const audits = snap.extraction.audits ?? []; const AIDED = /^(manual|trigger|runNow)/; const unaided = audits.filter((a) => !AIDED.test(String(a.reason ?? ''))); const playersIn = (w) => (ctx.chat ?? []).slice(Math.max(0, w.from), w.to + 1).filter((m) => m.is_user === true).map((m) => String(m.mes ?? '')); const norm = (text) => String(text ?? '').toLowerCase().replace(/[\u2018\u2019\u201c\u201d'"]/g, '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim(); const measured = unaided.filter((a) => (a.acceptedDeltas ?? []).length).map((a) => { const mine = playersIn(a.window).map(norm); return { reason: a.reason, window: a.window, evidence: a.acceptedDeltas.map((x) => ({ q: x.delta?.q ?? null, evidence: String(x.evidence ?? '') })).map((e) => ({ ...e, quotesPlayer: norm(e.evidence).length >= 12 && mine.some((line) => line.includes(norm(e.evidence))) })) }; }); if (!measured.length) throw new Error('no unaided read accepted anything, so there is no evidence to measure (J12.3 says why)'); const quoted = measured.flatMap((m) => m.evidence.filter((e) => e.quotesPlayer)); if (!quoted.length) throw new Error(`no accepted delta's evidence is a verbatim quote of a player line inside its read's window: ${JSON.stringify(measured)}`); return { quoted, measured };

checks.goal: the checkpoint the read opened applied its effects — an owned ledger row per effect, `applied` — and the boundary log names the transition that fired. This is the leg the MODEL decides, so it is its own check: a model that will not commit costs this check, not the journey's point (J12.3/J12.4). Revised 2026-09-25 (v2.4 plan 09 acceptance, lane 2): an accepted delta applies at the NEXT boundary, and at cadence 3 the cadence read fires on the third turn's boundary, so in two runs the model had accepted path=wendhope and the check reported that it had not; the check now lets the scheduler settle and plays one more real turn before it reads the checkpoint, and it names an accepted-but-unapplied path separately
